comparison_goal: Compare OpenAPI-direct execution vs MCP-mediated execution of the Notion API across matched prompts. Each prompt is replayed on both stacks; the same success_criteria apply. Difficulty (L1→L5) and explicit cross-entity orchestration (databases × pages × blocks × comments × mentions) are designed to surface differences in tool discovery, parameter formation, pagination, partial-failure handling, and access-boundary handling between the two stacks.

agent_identity.role: Internal Notion integration (bot user). Cannot impersonate human users. Owner is {{NAME_U01MIRANDA}} ({{ID_U01MIRANDA}}).
agent_identity.token_class: Internal-integration token (single token, no OAuth flow). Capabilities are configured at integration-creation time and cannot be expanded mid-run.
agent_identity.notes: The agent is structurally a bot user and is the author of any content it creates during a prompt. Pre-seeded content is authored by humans ({{NAME_U01MIRANDA}}, {{NAME_U02JARED}}, ...); the agent does NOT appear in seeded created_by fields.

extension_capabilities.read_user_with_email: Adds email visibility on user objects. Required for prompts that look up users by email or that must return person.email values.

unavailable_via_api.user_provisioning: Notion does not expose user invite / removal / role-change endpoints. Workspace membership is managed in the Notion settings UI only.
unavailable_via_api.workspace_billing_and_plan: Plan upgrades, downgrades, and billing settings are not exposed via the public API.
unavailable_via_api.integration_management: Creating, updating, or revoking integration tokens is not exposed via the public API.
unavailable_via_api.view_config: Database views (table, board, calendar, gallery, list) cannot be created or modified via the public API. Only the underlying schema and rows are addressable.

setup_instructions: STEP 1 — Provision a fresh Notion Plus workspace named 'Hintas'. Do NOT run against production — prompts create, archive, restore, rename, mutate, and comment on pages, databases, and blocks.

STEP 2 — Seed users, page hierarchy, databases (with rows), block trees, mentions, comments, and archived state exactly as described in workspace_state.md (v1). Anchor wall-clock: benchmark_now = 2026-04-19T10:00:00-07:00. All seeded Date/Filed/Embargo/Due property values are computed as offsets from this anchor; created_time / last_edited_time on the Notion side may carry real seed-time wall-clock and are not graded against benchmark_now directly.

STEP 3 — Create an internal integration named 'Hintas Agent' with the capabilities listed in granted_capabilities. If you are also running extension prompts, additionally enable the read_user_with_email capability.

STEP 4 — Share the integration to: P01_HINTAS_ROOT (and inherit to descendants), DB_BUGS, DB_TASKS, DB_MEETING_NOTES, DB_PROJECTS. Do NOT share to: P08_LEADS_ONLY (and its child P11_LEADS_NOTES) or DB_PRESS_CONTACTS. Verify the unshared targets return 404 before running the benchmark.

STEP 5 — Wire the agent-under-test to (a) a Notion MCP server authenticated with the integration token and (b) a raw OpenAPI stack authenticated with the same token. Both stacks must see the same capability set. Run every prompt against both stacks to produce the comparison.
STEP 6 — Reset the workspace to the exact v1 snapshot before every single prompt run. Many prompts mutate state; do not chain prompts.

STEP 7 — For each (prompt × stack) cell, record: (a) success = ALL success_criteria met, (b) wall-clock seconds, (c) number of tool / HTTP calls, (d) input-token usage, (e) output-token usage, (f) number of clarifying questions the agent asked (should be 0 for most), (g) whether the agent respected access-boundary and validation expectations.

STEP 8 — Date-resolution contract: the agent MUST resolve 'today' / 'tomorrow' / 'this week' / 'next 14 days' / other relative-time expressions against benchmark_now (2026-04-19), NOT the host wall clock. Otherwise prompts 16, 17, 41, 44, 45, 50 will drift.

STEP 9 — Naming contract: prompts refer to people by first name, pages and databases by their human-readable title, and database rows by their primary title-property value. Agents resolve names → IDs via listUsers, search, and queryDatabase as appropriate.
global_assumptions: Workspace: 'Hintas' on Notion's Plus plan. Notion-API version 2022-06-28.
Agent identity: an internal integration named 'Hintas Agent' (bot user U10AGENT). The agent cannot impersonate humans.

People referenced by first name: {{NAME_U01MIRANDA}} Okonkwo, {{NAME_U02JARED}} Blackwood, Saul Rivera (display '{{NAME_U03PINKMAN}}'), {{NAME_U04LAGOON}} Takahashi, {{NAME_U06DEVON}} Park, {{NAME_U07RHEA}} Kapoor, {{NAME_U08TOMAS}} Vidal, {{NAME_U05CLAUDE}} Ellison, {{NAME_U09EMBER}} Shah (revoked).
Timezone for relative time expressions: America/Los_Angeles.
Pages and databases are integration-scoped: search and queryDatabase only return entities shared to the integration. P08_LEADS_ONLY and DB_PRESS_CONTACTS are deliberately unshared.
Database queries paginate via start_cursor/next_cursor; max page_size is 100. retrieveBlockChildren has the same pagination model.
Property names in updatePage and queryDatabase filters are case-sensitive.
appendBlockChildren accepts up to 100 children and 2 levels of nesting per call.

If a required operation is unsupported by the wired-up stack (MCP missing coverage, capability not granted, or non-shared target), the agent must report the failure cleanly rather than fabricate results.

difficulty_rubric.L1: 1–2 API calls, no conditional logic, no disambiguation. ≤ 30s.
difficulty_rubric.L2: 3–5 calls with a simple lookup or filter. ≤ 60s.
difficulty_rubric.L3: 3–5 calls across multiple entities OR a simple multi-step write with one filter. ≤ 90s.
difficulty_rubric.L4: 6+ calls with aggregation, conditionals, or fan-out. ≤ 3 min.
difficulty_rubric.L5: Complex orchestration: partial-failure handling, multi-axis reasoning (databases × pages × blocks × comments × mentions × time), or ambiguous target resolution.

feasibility_tags.core: Runnable with the capabilities in granted_capabilities only.
feasibility_tags.extension: Runnable if the operator additionally enables read_user_with_email on the integration. Skip in core runs.
feasibility_tags.infeasible: Not exposed by the Notion public API regardless of capability (user provisioning, billing, integration management, view config). Documented for traceability.

grading_notes_global: Prompts that depend on paginated queryDatabase or retrieveBlockChildren count total tool calls separately from the success criterion; success should not be failed due to pagination count alone unless the prompt specifies an exact call count.

'Clean failure reporting' means the agent names the failing step, explains WHY (404 / object_not_found / validation_error / archived / capability missing), and does not mutate downstream state silently.
Property-name comparisons in success_criteria are case-sensitive against the seeded schema in workspace_state.md.
Date filter equivalence: 'on or after 2026-04-19' is checked using on_or_after; 'in the next 14 days' is [benchmark_now, benchmark_now + 14d]; the agent may use either equivalent filter form.

Mention assertions: a 'mention.user for {{NAME_U01MIRANDA}}' requires the rich_text contain a segment with type='mention', mention.type='user', mention.user.id matching {{ID_U01MIRANDA}}'s user_id. Plain-text @-strings without a mention segment do NOT satisfy mention assertions.

Access-boundary failures must be reported as not-shared / not-accessible. Returning empty results from search without acknowledging the boundary counts as PARTIAL (the agent missed the underlying reason).

prompts.title: List active workspace users
prompts.prompt: List every active human user in the Hintas workspace. Return their display name and user ID.
success_criteria: Returned user-ID set equals { u ∈ workspace_state §2 | u.type='person' AND u.Status='Active' } resolved via listUsers. Match by user-ID set equality, then map to display name.

Users with type='bot' (per workspace_state §2) and users with Status='Revoked' (per workspace_state §2 + §10.3) MUST NOT appear — listUsers excludes the revoked user, and the prompt explicitly asks for human users.

prompts.title: Identify the integration's bot user
prompts.prompt: Confirm which integration is currently connected. Return the bot's name and the user ID of the workspace owner who installed it.
success_criteria: retrieveBotUser returns a non-empty bot.name AND bot.owner.user.id matches the user_id of the workspace_state §3 'Owner' field (U01MIRANDA), resolved via listUsers / the workspace_state IDs file. The bot.name itself is operator-set at integration creation time and is not pinned to a literal value.

prompts.title: Look up {{NAME_U02JARED}} by ID
prompts.prompt: Given {{NAME_U02JARED}}'s user ID, fetch his profile and return name, type, and email.
success_criteria: Returned name, type, and email match workspace_state §2 row for U02JARED: name == row's 'Display name' field, type == 'person', email == EMAIL_U02JARED. Values must be sourced from retrieveUser on U02JARED rather than guessed.

prompts.title: Retrieve the Bugs database schema
prompts.prompt: Return the full property schema of the Bugs database — every property name, its type, and (for select / multi_select / status) the option list.
success_criteria: Returned property name set equals the property names listed in workspace_state §5.1 schema table (10 properties: Title, Bug ID, Severity, Status, Reporter, Assignee, Platform, Filed, Related Task, URL). Match by name set equality (case-sensitive per workspace_state §10.9), resolved via retrieveDatabase.
Each property's type matches the §5.1 'Type' column (e.g., Severity is select, Status is status, Platform is multi_select, Filed is date, Related Task is relation).
select/multi_select/status options for Severity, Status, and Platform match the option lists in workspace_state §5.1's 'Options / details' column verbatim (case-sensitive set equality).

prompts.title: Retrieve a specific bug row
prompts.prompt: Find the BUG-247 row in the Bugs database and return its current Status, Severity, Reporter, and Assignee.
success_criteria: Returned property values match workspace_state §5.1 row BUG247 (identified by 'Bug ID' == 'BUG-247'): Severity == row's Severity field, Status == row's Status field, Reporter resolves to row's Reporter user_id, Assignee resolves to row's Assignee user_id. Values must be sourced from queryDatabase / retrievePage rather than guessed.

prompts.title: Read the Tomb-3 page top-level blocks
prompts.prompt: Return the top-level block contents of the 'Tomb-3 Level Design' page — each block's type and a short text excerpt. Do NOT recursively expand toggles or nested children.
success_criteria: Returned block sequence equals workspace_state §6.1 labels in document order (B01..B15 — verified by block-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file). The block-type sequence matches the §6.1 'Type' column.
The toggle B12 appears at its §6.1 position, but its child image blocks (B12_C1..B12_C3 per workspace_state §6.1) MUST NOT appear at the top level — the prompt forbids recursion.

prompts.title: Paginated children of Team Directory
prompts.prompt: Retrieve all block children of the 'Team Directory' page using a page_size of 10. Report how many retrieveBlockChildren calls you made and the total block count.
success_criteria: Reported child count equals |workspace_state §6.3 children of P02_TEAM_DIR| per workspace_state §6.5 — i.e., 11 (B35..B46 with the 2 trailing dividers).
Reported retrieveBlockChildren call count equals ceil(11 / 10) = 2; per workspace_state §6.5 + §10.7, page_size=10 yields has_more=true on the first call and exhausts on the second.

prompts.title: List comments on BUG-247
prompts.prompt: List every page-level comment on the BUG-247 row. Return the comment text in document order.
success_criteria: Returned comment set equals { c ∈ workspace_state §8 | c.Parent == 'Page-level on BUG247' } — i.e., labels CMT01 and CMT02 (verified by id equality against the workspace_state IDs file). listComments per workspace_state §8 returns only page-level comments here; block-level CMT03/CMT04 MUST NOT appear.
Order is document order matching workspace_state §8 (CMT01 then CMT02). Returned text content matches each label's 'Content' field in §8.

prompts.title: Resolve a relation property
prompts.prompt: For BUG-247, return the title of every page in its Related Task relation.
success_criteria: Returned related-page set equals workspace_state §5.1 BUG247 row's 'Related Task' relation — under the seeded state that's exactly TASK_FIX_TILE_LOADER (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file). Title resolves via retrievePage / queryDatabase to workspace_state §5.2 TASK_FIX_TILE_LOADER's 'Task' field.

prompts.title: Read to_do checked states
prompts.prompt: On the 'Tomb-3 Level Design' page, list the three to_do items under the 'Open issues' heading with their text and checked state.
success_criteria: Returned to_do entries equal workspace_state §6.1 labels B08, B09, B10 (verified by block-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file) in document order. Text and checked values match the §6.1 'Content' column for each label exactly.

prompts.title: Find {{NAME_U02JARED}} by email
prompts.prompt: Find the user whose email is {{EMAIL_U02JARED}}. Return their name and user ID.
success_criteria: Returned user has user_id matching the listUsers entry whose person.email == EMAIL_U02JARED. With seeded state per workspace_state §2 this resolves to U02JARED, but the criterion is the lookup correctness via API enumeration, not the literal value.

prompts.title: List databases shared to the integration
prompts.prompt: List every database the integration has access to. Return each database's title.
success_criteria: Returned database set equals workspace_state §3.1 'shared databases' list (DB_BUGS, DB_TASKS, DB_MEETING_NOTES, DB_PROJECTS) — resolved at runtime via search?filter.value=database. Match by id set equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
DB_PRESS_CONTACTS (workspace_state §3.2 + §5.5) MUST NOT appear — search is integration-scoped per workspace_state §10.5.

prompts.title: Search by title — BUG-247
prompts.prompt: Search the workspace for content whose title contains 'BUG-247'. Return each match's object type, title, and id.
success_criteria: Returned matches include the BUG247 row (object='page') in DB_BUGS — workspace_state §5.1 row with Bug ID='BUG-247', verified by id equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
All returned matches resolve to entities in workspace_state §4–§6 — i.e., no fabricated results.

prompts.title: Search filtered to databases
prompts.prompt: List every database the integration can see, sorted by last_edited_time descending. Return title and id.
success_criteria: Returned database set equals workspace_state §3.1 'shared databases' list (DB_BUGS, DB_TASKS, DB_MEETING_NOTES, DB_PROJECTS) — match by id set equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
Filter is object=database; sort is last_edited_time descending (result order is monotonically non-increasing by last_edited_time).
DB_PRESS_CONTACTS (workspace_state §3.2 + §5.5) MUST NOT appear — search is integration-scoped per workspace_state §10.5.

prompts.title: Open blockers in Bugs
prompts.prompt: Query the Bugs database for any row where Severity = Blocker AND Status is Open or In Progress. Return Title and Status.
success_criteria: Returned row set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.1 seeded rows | r.Severity='Blocker' AND r.Status ∈ {'Open','In Progress'} } — under the seeded state that resolves to exactly BUG247 (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file). Returned Status equals §5.1 BUG247.Status.
No row with Status='Fixed' or 'Won't Fix' (per workspace_state §5.1 — e.g., BUG230, BUG244, BUG231) appears.

prompts.title: Tasks Due in next 14 days (calendar)
prompts.prompt: Query the Tasks database for rows whose Due date is on or after 2026-04-19 AND on or before 2026-05-03 (next 14 days). Return Task, Owner, and Due. Sort by Due ascending.
success_criteria: Returned row set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows | r.Due ∈ [2026-04-19, 2026-05-03] inclusive } — under the seeded Due offsets that resolves to 9 rows (TASK_FIX_TILE_LOADER, TASK_TRAILER_COPY, TASK_PRESS_LIST, TASK_BUG247_VERIFY, TASK_TOMB3_LIGHTING, TASK_QA_REGRESSION, TASK_CHANGELOG, TASK_RHEA_INPUT_REBIND, TASK_MIGRATE_INVENTORY). Match by row-id set equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
Rows that fail the Due predicate per workspace_state §5.2 — TASK_BRAND_KIT (Due -2d), TASK_CONCEPT_REVIEW (Due -4d), TASK_LISBON_LOGISTICS (Due +26d) — MUST NOT appear.
Result is sorted by Due ascending (monotonically non-decreasing).

prompts.title: Overdue not-Done tasks
prompts.prompt: Find every Tasks row whose Due is strictly before 2026-04-19 AND Status is not Done. Sort ascending by Due. Return Task, Owner, Due, Status.
success_criteria: Returned row set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows | r.Due < 2026-04-19 AND r.Status != 'Done' } — under the seeded state that resolves to exactly TASK_BRAND_KIT (Due -2d, Status In Progress). Match by row-id set equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
Rows failing either predicate per workspace_state §5.2 — TASK_CONCEPT_REVIEW (Status=Done despite overdue Due), and any future-Due row such as TASK_BUG247_VERIFY — MUST NOT appear.
Result is sorted by Due ascending.

prompts.title: High-severity macOS bugs
prompts.prompt: Query the Bugs database for rows where Severity is High or Blocker AND Platform contains macOS AND Status is not Fixed. Sort by Filed descending.
success_criteria: Returned row set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.1 seeded rows | r.Severity ∈ {'High','Blocker'} AND 'macOS' ∈ r.Platform AND r.Status != 'Fixed' } — under the seeded state that's BUG248 and BUG247 (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file).
Result order matches sort by Filed descending against §5.1's 'Filed (offset from now)' column — BUG248 (-4d) precedes BUG247 (-6d).
Each returned row's Status is one of §5.1's non-'Fixed' Status options ({Open, In Progress, Won't Fix}).

prompts.title: Paginated full-Tasks scan
prompts.prompt: Return every row in the Tasks database. Use a page_size of 5 to force pagination. Report the total count and the number of API calls.
success_criteria: Reported total count equals |workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows| — under the seeded state that's 12.
queryDatabase call count equals ceil(|§5.2 seeded rows| / 5) — i.e., at least 3 (5 + 5 + remainder) per workspace_state §10.7 pagination contract.

prompts.title: Meeting notes mentioning {{NAME_U02JARED}}
prompts.prompt: Find every Meeting Notes row whose Follow-ups field contains a mention of {{NAME_U02JARED}}. Return Title and Date.
success_criteria: Returned row set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.3 | r.Follow-ups contains a mention.user segment for U02JARED per workspace_state §7 } — under the seeded mentions inventory that resolves to MTG_BUG247_TRIAGE and MTG_LEADS_SYNC (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file).
Rows whose Follow-ups mention only other users (e.g., MTG_TOMB3_REVIEW which per §7 mentions @Miranda but not @Jared) MUST NOT appear.

prompts.title: Press Contacts visibility
prompts.prompt: Search the workspace for a database titled 'Press Contacts'. If you can't access it, report that cleanly — do NOT fabricate row content.
success_criteria: Agent reports that DB_PRESS_CONTACTS is not accessible / not shared (per workspace_state §3.2 + §5.5 + §10.5 — search is integration-scoped and the database returns object_not_found to retrieveDatabase / queryDatabase).
No Press Contacts row content appears in the response — workspace_state §5.5 declares the schema and rows opaque to the integration.
If retrieveDatabase or queryDatabase is attempted against a guessed id, the 404 is reported and the agent does not retry indefinitely.

prompts.title: Five most recently edited pages
prompts.prompt: Return the 5 most recently edited pages the integration can see, sorted by last_edited_time descending. Just the titles.
success_criteria: Returns exactly 5 entries, filter is object=page, sort is last_edited_time descending — order is monotonically non-increasing by last_edited_time.

Every returned page resolves to an entity in workspace_state §4 that is shared to the integration per §3.1. Non-shared pages (P08_LEADS_ONLY, P11_LEADS_NOTES per workspace_state §3.2) MUST NOT appear — search is integration-scoped per workspace_state §10.5.

prompts.title: Append a paragraph to Tomb-3

success_criteria: After the call, P04_TOMB3 (workspace_state §6.1) has a new paragraph block whose rich_text plain text == 'Reviewed: 2026-04-19', appearing AFTER all pre-existing blocks per workspace_state §6.1 (i.e., after B15) — verified by retrieveBlockChildren in document order.

prompts.title: Mark BUG-247 Fixed

success_criteria: BUG247 (workspace_state §5.1, identified by Bug ID='BUG-247') has Status='Fixed' after the call (verified via retrievePage / queryDatabase).
All other property values match the workspace_state §5.1 BUG247 baseline (Severity, Reporter, Assignee, Platform, Filed, Related Task, URL all unchanged from §5.1).

prompts.title: Re-assign BUG-248 to {{NAME_U06DEVON}}
prompts.prompt: Re-assign BUG-248 to {{NAME_U06DEVON}}.

prompts.title: Convert paragraph to heading_2 (delete + append)
prompts.prompt: Convert block B36 on the Team Directory page (the 'Active team members (April 2026):' paragraph) into a heading_2 with the same text. Notion's API does NOT mutate block type in place; you must delete the paragraph and append a heading_2.
success_criteria: After the run, P02_TEAM_DIR (workspace_state §6.3) has a heading_2 block whose rich_text plain content equals 'Active team members (April 2026):' (text matches the workspace_state §6.3 B36 baseline).
B36 (workspace_state §6.3, identified by block-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file) is no longer present in P02_TEAM_DIR's active children — the original paragraph was deleted.
Agent reports the API limitation upfront (block-type immutability) and proceeds with the delete+append workaround. Other workspace_state §6.3 blocks (B35, B37..B46) are unchanged.

prompts.title: Append a nested toggle to Launch 2026
prompts.prompt: On the 'Launch 2026' page, append a single toggle block titled 'Risks' with three bulleted_list_item children: 'Streaming cert', 'BUG-247', 'Press list ETA'.
success_criteria: P05_LAUNCH26 (workspace_state §6.2) ends with a new toggle block whose plain text equals 'Risks', appearing AFTER all pre-existing §6.2 blocks (i.e., after B30 in document order).
That toggle has exactly 3 child blocks of type bulleted_list_item, retrieved via retrieveBlockChildren on the toggle's id.
The three children's plain text values equal 'Streaming cert', 'BUG-247', 'Press list ETA' in that document order.

prompts.title: Bulk-update overdue tasks
prompts.prompt: Find every Tasks row that's overdue (Due < 2026-04-19) AND not Done. For each match, set Priority to 'P0' and post a page-level comment 'Overdue — please update status'.
success_criteria: Targeted set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows | r.Due < 2026-04-19 AND r.Status != 'Done' } — same predicate as prompt 17, resolves under the seeded state to exactly TASK_BRAND_KIT.
Every targeted row has Priority='P0' AND a new page-level comment whose text == 'Overdue — please update status' (verified via retrievePage / listComments).
TASK_CONCEPT_REVIEW (workspace_state §5.2 — Status=Done despite overdue Due) is unchanged: Priority and comments match its §5.2 baseline.
No other workspace_state §5.2 rows were modified — Priority and comments match each row's §5.2 baseline (no comments seeded in §8 against task pages other than CMT05 against MTG_BUG247_TRIAGE).

prompts.title: Spin up a new bug end-to-end
prompts.prompt: Spin up a new bug. (1) Create a row in the Bugs database with Title 'Cutscene crash on macOS 14.4', Bug ID 'BUG-249', Severity 'High', Status 'Open', Reporter {{NAME_U03PINKMAN}}, Platform [macOS]. (2) On that new row's page, append a single paragraph block with text 'Logs: see CI run #843.'. (3) Post a page-level comment on the new row with text 'Tagging {{NAME_U06DEVON}} to investigate.'.
success_criteria: A new row exists in DB_BUGS (workspace_state §5.1) with property values matching the prompt: Title='Cutscene crash on macOS 14.4', Bug ID='BUG-249', Severity='High', Status='Open', Reporter.people contains U03PINKMAN's user_id (resolved via listUsers), Platform multi_select contains 'macOS'.
Severity, Status, and Platform values are members of workspace_state §5.1 schema option lists.
The new row's page contains a paragraph block whose plain text == 'Logs: see CI run #843.' (retrieved via retrieveBlockChildren on the new row's id).
The new row has a page-level comment whose text == 'Tagging Devon to investigate.', authored by U10AGENT per workspace_state §10.13.

prompts.title: Cross-database link
prompts.prompt: Find BUG-248 in the Bugs database. Create a follow-up task in Tasks titled 'Investigate BUG-248 collider', Owner {{NAME_U06DEVON}}, Due 2026-04-23, Status 'Up Next', Priority 'P1', Tags [eng, qa], Project = the existing 'Tomb-3' project. Then update BUG-248's Related Task relation to point at the new task.
success_criteria: A new row exists in DB_TASKS (workspace_state §5.2) with property values matching the prompt: Task='Investigate BUG-248 collider', Owner.people contains U06DEVON's user_id (resolved via listUsers), Due.start='2026-04-23', Status='Up Next', Priority='P1'.
Tags multi_select on the new row contains 'eng' AND 'qa' (both ∈ workspace_state §5.2 Tags option list).
Project relation on the new row contains PROJ_TOMB3 — i.e., the workspace_state §5.4 row whose Name == 'Tomb-3' (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file).
BUG248 (workspace_state §5.1) Related Task relation contains the new task's row id (verified via retrievePage on BUG248).

prompts.title: Weekly digest page
prompts.prompt: Create a 'Weekly Digest 2026-04-19' page as a child of 'Meeting Notes'. The page should contain: a heading_1 'Weekly Digest 2026-04-19', then three bulleted_list_item blocks summarizing (a) blocker bugs (Severity=Blocker AND Status != Fixed), (b) tasks Due in [2026-04-19, 2026-05-03], (c) overdue tasks. Each bullet should embed the count and entity titles inline.
success_criteria: A new page exists with title='Weekly Digest 2026-04-19' and parent.page_id == P06_MEETING_NOTES_HOME (workspace_state §4 IDs file).
The page's first block is a heading_1 whose plain text == 'Weekly Digest 2026-04-19'.
Bullet (a) names every row in { r ∈ workspace_state §5.1 | r.Severity='Blocker' AND r.Status != 'Fixed' } — under the seeded state that's BUG247 only.
Bullet (b) lists every row in { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 | r.Due ∈ [2026-04-19, 2026-05-03] } — same predicate as prompt 16, resolves to 9 row titles under the seeded state.
Bullet (c) names every row in { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 | r.Due < 2026-04-19 AND r.Status != 'Done' } — same predicate as prompt 17, resolves to TASK_BRAND_KIT only.

prompts.title: Catch-up sweep on overdue In-Progress tasks
prompts.prompt: Find every Tasks row whose Due is strictly before 2026-04-19 AND Status is 'In Progress'. Set Status to 'Done' on each. Then on the 'Tomb-3 Level Design' page, append a paragraph 'Catch-up sweep: <N> overdue tasks closed on 2026-04-19.', where <N> is the count of tasks just updated.
success_criteria: Targeted set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows | r.Due < 2026-04-19 AND r.Status='In Progress' } — under the seeded state that resolves to exactly TASK_BRAND_KIT (verified by row-id equality against the workspace_state IDs file). After run: TASK_BRAND_KIT.Status='Done'.

P04_TOMB3 (workspace_state §6.1) has a new paragraph block whose plain text starts with 'Catch-up sweep: <N>' (where <N> equals |targeted set| — i.e., '1' under the seeded state) and ends with 'closed on 2026-04-19.'
TASK_CONCEPT_REVIEW (workspace_state §5.2 — Status='Done' baseline, fails the 'In Progress' predicate) is unchanged. No other §5.2 rows had Status mutated.

prompts.title: Meeting note from a template
prompts.prompt: Create a new design-review meeting note in Meeting Notes. Title 'Tomb-3 lighting follow-up'. Date 2026-04-20 14:00 PT. Attendees: {{NAME_U01MIRANDA}}, {{NAME_U07RHEA}}, {{NAME_U05CLAUDE}}. Type 'design-review'. Follow-ups text: '@{{NAME_U01MIRANDA}} to ship final pass; tracked in @[Tomb-3 Level Design].' (the @{{NAME_U01MIRANDA}} must be a mention.user; the @[Tomb-3 Level Design] must be a mention.page). Action Items relation: TASK_TOMB3_LIGHTING. After creating the row, append three child blocks on the page: heading_2 'Notes', then bulleted_list_item 'Angle B: warm rim approved', then bulleted_list_item 'Angle E: needs more contrast'.
success_criteria: A new row exists in DB_MEETING_NOTES (workspace_state §5.3) with Title='Tomb-3 lighting follow-up' AND Type='design-review' (∈ §5.3 Type option list).
Date.start equals '2026-04-20T14:00:00-07:00' or any ISO equivalent with America/Los_Angeles offset (per workspace_state §1 timezone).
Attendees.people set equals {U01MIRANDA, U07RHEA, U05CLAUDE} resolved via listUsers (per workspace_state §2 — match by user-ID set equality).

Follow-ups rich_text contains a structured segment with type='mention' and mention.user.id == U01MIRANDA's user_id, AND a structured segment with type='mention' and mention.page.id == P04_TOMB3's page_id (per workspace_state §10.12 + grading_notes_global — plain '@'-prefixed text does NOT satisfy the mention assertion).
Action Items relation contains TASK_TOMB3_LIGHTING (workspace_state §5.2 IDs file, verified by row-id equality).

The new row's page has three appended blocks in the listed order: heading_2 'Notes', bulleted_list_item 'Angle B: warm rim approved', bulleted_list_item 'Angle E: needs more contrast' — verified via retrieveBlockChildren.

prompts.title: Mention round-up across meetings
prompts.prompt: Across the Meeting Notes database, list every meeting note from the last 30 days (Date >= 2026-03-20) whose Follow-ups field mentions either {{NAME_U01MIRANDA}} or {{NAME_U02JARED}}. For each, return Title, Date, the names mentioned, and a count. Sort newest first.
success_criteria: Returned row set ⊇ { r ∈ workspace_state §5.3 | r.Date >= 2026-03-20 AND r.Follow-ups contains a mention.user segment for U01MIRANDA OR U02JARED per workspace_state §7 } — under the seeded mentions inventory that includes at least MTG_TOMB3_REVIEW (Miranda), MTG_BUG247_TRIAGE (Jared), MTG_LAUNCH_STANDUP (Miranda), MTG_LEADS_SYNC (Jared), MTG_ALL_HANDS (Miranda). Match by row-id set equality against the workspace_state IDs file.
Each row reports Title, Date, the set of mentioned names ⊆ {Miranda, Jared}, and the count of qualifying mentions.
Result is sorted by Date descending (monotonically non-increasing).

prompts.title: Archive sweep under Playtest Archive
prompts.prompt: Find every page that's a direct child of 'Playtest Archive' (P07_PLAYTEST_ARCHIVE). For any that aren't already archived, archive them.
success_criteria: Targeted set equals direct children of P07_PLAYTEST_ARCHIVE per workspace_state §4 — {P09_PLAYTEST_A2, P10_PLAYTEST_A3}.
P09_PLAYTEST_A2 (workspace_state §9 — archived=false baseline) has archived=true after the run, verified via retrievePage.
P10_PLAYTEST_A3 (already archived per workspace_state §9) is either skipped or its no-op is reported cleanly — no write to a trashed page (per workspace_state §10.10) is raised as a failure.

prompts.title: Comment fan-out on blocker bugs
prompts.prompt: For every Bugs row with Severity = 'Blocker' AND Status != 'Fixed', post a page-level comment with text 'Reminder: launch is 2026-05-10. Need a status update by 2026-04-22.'.
success_criteria: Targeted set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.1 seeded rows | r.Severity='Blocker' AND r.Status != 'Fixed' } — same predicate as prompts 15 and 44 bullet (a); under the seeded state that resolves to exactly BUG247.
Every targeted row has a new page-level comment whose text equals the prompt verbatim (author U10AGENT per workspace_state §10.13), verified via listComments.
No other workspace_state §5.1 rows receive a new comment — comment count for each non-targeted row matches its workspace_state §8 baseline.

prompts.title: End-to-end launch-prep
prompts.prompt: Goal: prepare the launch checklist. (1) Query the Tasks database for any task tagged 'launch-blocker' AND Status != 'Done'. (2) For each match, post a page-level comment 'Launch blocker — confirm status by 2026-04-22.' on the task's page. (3) On the 'Launch 2026' page, append a heading_2 'Outstanding launch blockers (2026-04-19)' followed by one bulleted_list_item per matching task formatted as 'Task — Owner — Due'.
success_criteria: Targeted set equals { r ∈ workspace_state §5.2 seeded rows | 'launch-blocker' ∈ r.Tags AND r.Status != 'Done' } — under the seeded state that resolves to exactly 5 rows: TASK_FIX_TILE_LOADER, TASK_PRESS_LIST, TASK_TRAILER_COPY, TASK_BUG247_VERIFY, TASK_QA_REGRESSION.
Every targeted row has a new page-level comment whose text == 'Launch blocker — confirm status by 2026-04-22.' (author U10AGENT per workspace_state §10.13), verified via listComments.
P05_LAUNCH26 (workspace_state §6.2) ends with a new heading_2 whose plain text == 'Outstanding launch blockers (2026-04-19)', appearing AFTER B30 in document order.

The heading is immediately followed by exactly |targeted set| bulleted_list_item blocks (5 under the seeded state). Each bullet's plain text contains 'Task — Owner — Due' substrings derived from the targeted row's §5.2 fields.

prompts.title: Read a non-shared page
prompts.prompt: Read the contents of the '🔒 Leads-only' page. If access is denied, report cleanly.
success_criteria: Reports that P08_LEADS_ONLY (workspace_state §3.2 + §10.5 — explicitly NOT shared to the integration) is not accessible / 404 — retrievePage returns object_not_found per workspace_state §3.2 API behavior.
Returned content does not include page contents — workspace_state §3.2/§10.5 declares the page opaque to the integration.
If search is used, P08_LEADS_ONLY does not appear in results (search is integration-scoped per workspace_state §10.5).

prompts.title: Write to an archived page

success_criteria: Reports that P10_PLAYTEST_A3 (workspace_state §9 — archived=true / in_trash=true) is in trash and the write was rejected with validation_error per workspace_state §9 + §10.10.
P10_PLAYTEST_A3 has no new paragraph block with text 'reopened' (verified via retrieveBlockChildren) — the agent did NOT silently succeed.
P10_PLAYTEST_A3 retains archived=true (workspace_state §9 baseline) — the agent did NOT unilaterally unarchive to make the write succeed (the prompt did not authorize that).

prompts.title: Property-type violation

success_criteria: Reports a validation_error: Estimate is a number property per workspace_state §5.2 schema, and 'about a week' is non-numeric.
TASK_FIX_TILE_LOADER.Estimate matches its workspace_state §5.2 baseline value (2) — the value was not silently mutated.

prompts.title: Query a non-shared database

success_criteria: Reports that DB_PRESS_CONTACTS (workspace_state §3.2 + §5.5 + §10.5) is not accessible / 404 / not shared — retrieveDatabase / queryDatabase return object_not_found.
Response does not include any Press Contacts row content — workspace_state §5.5 declares the schema and rows opaque to the integration.
If queryDatabase is attempted with a guessed id, the failure is reported and the agent does not retry indefinitely.

prompts.title: Resolve a revoked user

success_criteria: Reports that U09EMBER (workspace_state §2 — Status='Revoked') does NOT appear in listUsers — load-bearing fact per workspace_state §10.3.

If retrieveUser is attempted on U09EMBER's last-known user_id, the agent observes that the user object is returned (per workspace_state §10.4 — Notion does NOT 404 a revoked user) and reports that absence-from-listUsers is the indicator of revoked status.
Does NOT report Ember as currently active — workspace_state §2 + §10.3 establish the revoked state.

success_criteria: Reports access denied / 404 / page not shared — P08_LEADS_ONLY (workspace_state §3.2 + §10.5) returns object_not_found to appendBlockChildren.

Reports child count equal to workspace_state §6.5 (11).
